mapper.sql: id, owner_user_id, owner_name_snapshot, owner_role_snapshot, label, tool_name, args_json, fire_at, status, session_id, message_id, created_at, claimed_at, fired_at, cancelled_at, confirmed_by, result_text, ok, error_message, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_timer (owner_user_id, owner_name_snapshot, owner_role_snapshot, label, tool_name, args_json, fire_at, status, session_id, message_id) VALUES (#{ownerUserId}, #{ownerNameSnapshot}, #{ownerRoleSnapshot}, #{label}, #{toolName}, #{argsJson}, #{fireAt}, #{status}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_timer WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_timer SET status = 'FIRING', claimed_at = #{claimedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ai_timer SET status = 'FIRED', fired_at = #{firedAt}, result_text = #{resultText}, ok = #{ok}, error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FIRING'
UPDATE ai_timer SET status = 'AWAITING_CONFIRM', claimed_at = #{claimedAt}, ok = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FIRING'
UPDATE ai_timer SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'AWAITING_CONFIRM') AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ai_timer SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, error_message = '到点后未确认，已放弃' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'AWAITING_CONFIRM' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE ai_timer SET status = 'FAILED', fired_at = #{now}, ok = 0, error_message = '执行中断（服务重启或执行中异常），未记录结果' WHERE status = 'FIRING' AND (claimed_at IS NULL OR claimed_at < #{before})
